title: ZIP Barely Shrinks Your PDF? Optimize the Document Itself
description: Understand why ZIP may barely shrink a PDF on iPhone. Compress the document itself, then compare actual size, page count and readability.
direct: If ZIP barely shrinks your PDF, try compressing the document itself. Check the saved PDF against the recipient’s limit while keeping the original.
figureAlt: Putting a PDF into an archive packages the document rather than directly changing its embedded picture.

cards.decision.heading: Start with the decision
cards.decision.body: Many PDFs already contain compressed image data and document streams. An archive compressor may find little remaining redundancy. A portal that requires PDF may also reject ZIP, even when the archive is slightly smaller.
sections.detail-0.heading: Packaging and optimization differ
sections.detail-0.body: ZIP is useful for grouping files and can compress some content efficiently. PDF optimization works on the document’s own representation. Adobe’s optimization guidance distinguishes elements such as images and fonts, but our app does not promise every Acrobat optimization control. An image-heavy scan and an already compact text document can respond very differently.
sections.detail-1.heading: Use the smaller useful copy
sections.detail-1.body: Its current listing offers compression, batch compression and saved or shared exports. One export-tool use is free; further exports require Pro. No fixed percentage or exact size is guaranteed. Keep signed originals and follow the recipient’s requirements before modifying certified documents. If compression does not produce an acceptable readable PDF, an approved sharing method may be more appropriate than repeatedly compressing the same copy.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: Can I send a ZIP if the form asks for PDF?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: Use a PDF when the form requires that format. A ZIP is an archive, even if it contains the right document.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: Why does a scanned PDF shrink more than a text PDF?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: An image-heavy scan may have more room for image optimization. A compact text PDF may offer little additional saving, so check each output separately.

related.related.label: Compress a Scanned PDF While Keeping Small Text Readable
steps.step-1.text: Keep the source PDF. Check whether the recipient accepts PDF or ZIP and note the actual size limit before changing the document.
steps.step-2.text: Open the PDF in PDF Compressor: Sign & Merge and use its compression tool. Export a new PDF rather than merely placing the old one inside an archive.
steps.step-3.text: Compare the saved size, page count, small print and images with the original. Open the exact output in the receiving workflow. Stop reducing quality if essential details become unclear.
